Messages.Author: Ector
Messages.Body:
Power of All has text: "Tap this anarch and one other untapped ready
anarch you control to cancel a library card as it is played." If I
have one tapped and one untapped anarch, what happens if I try to Wake
the tapped anarch and play Power of All to cancel something?

A). I cannot play Power of All since I cannot tap 2 anarchs.
B). I can play Power of All, but it wouldn't work, since I cannot tap
2 Anarchs.
C). I can play Power of All, and it would work.

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:


A). "tap to" requires you are untapped.

See also: http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/09cfcaba9e257a23

Here's the rules text:
1.6.1.1.
Some effects can cancel a card "as it is played." These effects (and
effects that grant the ability to play them, like Forced Awakening)
are the only effects allowed during the "as played" time period of
another card.

I assume that Guard Dogs, Rat's Warning and Predator's Communion are
the effects that grant the ability to play other cards, like Power of
All. Or they aren't?
I was wondering whether these card can be played in that window - is
the acting minion already bleeding after playing Legal Manipulations
or not?

> I was wondering whether these card can be played in that window - is
> the acting minion already bleeding after playing Legal Manipulations
> or not?

Yes. Xe is acting, the action is a bleed action, etc. even before DI
is played (and if DI is then played, xe is not acting, etc.)
